payload.summary: Closed the Constitution dialog and pressed "Three Founding Authorities — implemented today" on /dao-preview. A dialog opened titled "Three Founding Authorities" showing "Implemented today" and its description ("Three distinct people must accept before activation.").

endAnchors.text: Three distinct people must accept before activation.
The creator becomes Founding Authority #1 and appoints two more by secure invitation. Each accepts independently with Internet Identity, so no single person can activate a Nation alone.
Proposals, debate and voting with a clear tally — enforced by the constitution, not by whoever holds the keys.

goneAnchors.text: The written rules every decision answers to.
Your founding document: membership thresholds, voting rules and the safeguards that protect them. Amendments follow the same approved process as any other decision.
A private home for your people — members, roles and a shared place to work, with nothing public until you decide it is.
